parsed.reason: This message violates multiple high-weight scoring criteria: (1) it points at a website/settings page rather than asking to text the address; (2) it includes a deadline ("within 24 hours") creating pressure and urgency; (3) it uses a greeting ("Hi there!") and an exclamation mark; (4) it doesn't clearly state what the person gets for providing their email—it only asks "Want invites?" rather than promising invites will be sent; (5) it includes hype/enthusiasm markers that contradict the "quiet, plain" requirement. The reference shows the correct register and structure—simple, first person, no greeting, offering a clear exchange (real calendar invites for an email address via text). This message fails on nearly every dimension.
